scope: Local loopback HTTP; real auth and API handlers; in-memory SQL; synthetic accounts; external networking blocked

results.check: Authenticated HTTP context trusts ingress metadata only on transformed origins
Unauthenticated and forged sessions cannot read financial APIs
Forged trusted-session headers cannot bypass authentication
Authenticated responses are private and never touch shared cache
Switching workspace with the same token returns current authorised data
Scoped REST API keys cannot bypass scopes through dashboard tRPC
Integration read and update responses do not disclose provider credentials
A failed HMRC refresh keeps saved obligations and reports a safe error
Integration disconnect responses do not disclose removed credentials
CORS does not allow an attacker origin
HMRC state rejects tampering and expired encrypted payloads
HMRC state is browser-bound and consumed atomically once
HMRC callback rejects missing browser binding before token exchange
File path validation rejects plain and encoded traversal
Session revocation takes effect on the next request
